interpretation: The full measured MaleCNS and V5 sensory/core policy remain frozen and active. Only the existing small motor readout output layers are changed. V11 replaces the non-scalable requirement to place every historical prefix state in the exact nullspace with an adaptive active constraint set. The set starts with recent states, evenly-spaced historical anchors, and the lowest action-margin states. Every proposal is then replayed deterministically from the seed through the intended frontier. If any earlier action changes, that exact state is added as a witness constraint and the nullspace update is recomputed. A candidate is evaluated on the full horizon only after its first action divergence is exactly the requested frontier. This preserves the full closed-loop action prefix while avoiding automatic nullspace exhaustion near feature dimension 773. The V10 quality budget, tactical bridges, transaction rewind, progress floor, stall limit, and global/marginal blocked-action gates remain enforced.
